text:
mira_pm: Heads-up: small creative sprint for the Jun 12 webinar. Need a compact asset bundle for paid ads, registration page, and the slide deck.

eli_design: Outline the exact files and specs?

mira_pm: Deliverables (priority order):
1) Landing hero (1600x600) + email hero (1200x628) — static, 3 copy variants for A/B.
2) Benchmark slide (1920x1080) — simplified scatter chart (latency ms vs $/1k tokens) with three annotated points (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and an overlay callout that shows "after caching/routing" effect. Include a 1-panel visual teardown (1200x600) extracted from the slide for social.
3) Social tiles: square (1080x1080), story (1080x1920, tiny loop ok <1.5MB), and Linkedin banner (1200x627).
4) Source Figma with one text layer per string for EN/FR/DE localizations + CSV-ready page. Exports: PNG for email/web, WebP for social, SVG for diagram elements, high-res PDF for deck.

sam_content: Copy payload: primary headline "Predictable inference at product scale"; alt headline "Ship LLM features with reliable latency"; subhead "Jun 12 webinar: live demo + benchmark"; CTA "Register". I'll push translations tonight. Also adding alt text for accessibility.

eli_design: Noted. Any brand guardrails? colors, prohibited imagery, logo usage?

mira_pm: Use primary palette; avoid #c63232 (alarm red) for chart markers. Use teal + warm orange for accents. No competitor logos; neutral labels only. Keep hero image abstract (no stock people with identifiable faces).

jia_i18n: Reminder: keep all copy editable. Separate frames per locale. Avoid idioms/wordplays. We can turn around FR/DE within 12 hours if strings are clean.

nora_legal: If using any customer quotes/logos, attach proof of permission. Also flag any regulatory claims (e.g., "enterprise-grade SLA") and we'll vet. I can do a 2-hour turnaround on final assets if pinged.

eli_design: Quick question re: benchmark viz — should we include axis ticks and units or keep minimal?

mira_pm: Add axis labels & ticks but minimal gridlines. Annotate the three points with short captions and one small legend. Callout bubble: "Smart routing & caching cuts effective cost".

devops-bot: Reminder: webinar deployment checklist due Jun 10 — add asset links to the central runbook.

eli_design: I'll create the Figma file now and add an assets page per locale + an export preset. Will avoid embedding copy in images. Initial comps ETA: tomorrow 11am PT.

sam_content: I'll upload final copy and two micro-copy CTA variants by 9am PT tomorrow.

jia_i18n: Once I get source, I'll queue FR/DE localization. Please keep character count short for social headlines.

mira_pm: Priority if anything slips: keep benchmark slide ready for the deck. Social can be slightly delayed but try to meet EOD Wed. Thanks team — drop blockers here. :rocket:
